subject: Sara Jensen — leveling & offer recommendation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sara Jensen — leveling & offer recommendation

Hi Vivek / Lauren,

Following the onsite loop, the hiring committee landed on a consensus recommendation of L3 for Sara Jensen. I’ve attached the combined interviewer notes and the proposed offer (proposed_offer_v1.docx) that corresponds to L3 banding.

Vivek, you previously indicated you were leaning toward L4 given Sara’s leadership examples and cross-team PM work at her last role. There’s a mismatch between your verbal feedback and the committee notes — two of the interviewers called out scope/ambiguity handling as a concern.

Can you share a short justification for L4 (2–3 bullets) so Lauren can evaluate calibration versus the committee recommendation? HR prefers a brief written rationale rather than a long thread. If HR supports L4, we’ll adjust the comp band and the offer template. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the L3 offer and confirm next steps for onsite debrief and candidate communication.

Attachments: interview_notes_sara_jensen.pdf, proposed_offer_v1.docx

Thanks,
Monica

monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Candidate: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@example.com> (cc on later threads once offer is finalized)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-17T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sara Jensen — leveling & offer recommendation

Monica / Lauren —

Thanks for surfacing. Short rationale for L4:
- Sara led a cross-functional initiative at her last company that shipped a multi-quarter product and owned roadmapping, stakeholder prioritization and trade-offs — scope consistent with our L4 PMs.
- Her interview on product sense included a scenario where she decomposed a vague problem into metrics, success criteria and an execution plan; that level of abstraction + execution trade-offs is what we expect at L4.
- She has direct reports/mentorship responsibilities and has run prioritization for multiple teams, per her manager reference.

I understand the committee had concerns about ambiguity handling in two sessions; I’d like a short calibration call to align expectations rather than default to L3. If HR prefers written examples I can expand the bullets, but I think the evidence leans L4.

Proposed offer on my side (if L4 approved): base $170k + target equity + standard RSU cliff — roughly at the midpoint of L4 band. If we keep L3, I’m worried about retention — she has another competitive offer on the table.

Happy to join a 30-min calibration at Lauren’s earliest.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Manager, Product — Core Serving
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai | x4-220

Vivek / team —

I appreciate the perspective and the leadership examples you shared. For transparency from the interviewer side: two interviewers reported that Sara struggled to define success metrics in an ambiguous roadmap problem and relied heavily on stakeholder alignment anecdotes rather than concrete execution plans. Those observations are material to leveling because they speak to autonomous execution scope.

That said, another interviewer rated product sense highly and noted strong stakeholder management. I’m not opposed to a short calibration discussion to compare concrete examples.

Happy to summarize the two interviews in one page if that helps the HR review.

-Neha

Subject: Re: Sara Jensen — leveling & offer recommendation

Thanks all —

I’ll coordinate a short calibration call and then provide a leveling decision with rationale. Proposed next steps:
1) Vivek — please expand your bullets into 2–3 concrete examples (one paragraph each) that map to our leveling rubric (scope, autonomy, leadership). Put those examples in the attached calibration_template.docx.
2) Neha — could you and the two interviewers provide 1-paragraph summaries of the concerns (metrics, ambiguity examples) — we only need the key datapoints.
3) Monica — hold the verbal offer until we close calibration; if the candidate has an outside offer, please capture the timeline and any ask.

I’ve tentatively scheduled a 30-min slot on Fri 3/20 at 10:30 AM PT — calendar invite coming. If that doesn’t work, please propose alternatives today. After the call HR will confirm leveling and the adjusted offer (if any) within 24 hours.

Attachments: calibration_template.docx

-Lauren
